findings.description: Unauthenticated /health flood dilutes the global-sum SLI; a real 50% outage reads 0.9804% and 500ms p95 reads 4.8ms, both under budget (proven with prom-parse.js). f3c25eb only removed self-observation.
findings.fix: Aggregate the SLI per business route in prom-parse.js; add rate limiting with the group-B auth layer.

findings.description: A DB URI with inline user:password is dropped in a context value but egresses verbatim through detail, which bypasses the _CREDENTIAL_URI guard. Latent at HEAD (no AppError raised).
findings.fix: Run detail through the same credential-URI guard and length cap as context values in _envelope.

findings.description: Redaction is inert: zero register_sensitive call sites. sanitise_context egressed a 12-digit Aadhaar int, a PAN in a key, and a PAN in a value verbatim. Latent until business PII flows.
findings.fix: Wire register_sensitive at PII-introducing operations; normalise-then-match in the sanitiser.

findings.description: _escape_label passes raw CR/TAB/NUL/BEL/ESC/DEL. Confirmed UNREACHABLE at HEAD: no attacker string reaches a label; live CRLF-path attack produced no raw CR in the body.
findings.fix: Escape all control characters, not just backslash/quote/newline.

findings.description: observe_duration does not bound its own method dimension (22,003 raw methods -> 12.3MB if called directly). Not reachable over HTTP; record_request bounds it first.
/health and /metrics unauthenticated (documented, ratified group-B deferral). Discloses version 0.1.0, DB liveness, route templates, per-route counts and latency histogram.
findings.fix: Add auth with E1-S1 (group B) as scoped.

findings.description: X-Request-ID reflected and logged verbatim (callers own data); oversized bounded to 400 at the server header limit.
Unchanged by these commits: public /docs and /openapi.json, missing security headers, host-header open redirect. Out of scope for this diff; no regression.
findings.fix: Address with the group-B security-header/auth work.
